presets.label: Product Image Set
required_brief: usable product reference, or an explicitly fictional concept
deliverables: coordinated main, feature and lifestyle images as requested
presets.guidance: Preserve the supplied product and supported claims. One coordinated task; do not upload a listing to a marketplace.

presets.label: A+ Detail Page
deliverables: ordered A+ or detail-page visual modules
presets.guidance: Use the requested module ratio and order; 970:600 is one website option, not a universal rule. No HTML deployment or editable-source claim without actual artifacts.

presets.label: White Background Photos
deliverables: clean product image on a white background
presets.guidance: Preserve product details, proportions and included items; do not promise pixel-exact preservation or marketplace approval.

presets.label: Product Lifestyle Images
required_brief: product reference or an explicitly fictional concept
presets.guidance: Use credible scale and context; do not add accessories as included products or invent product claims.

presets.label: Product Variants
deliverables: requested variants with the same identifying product details
presets.guidance: Clarify whether variants are actual saleable configurations or design concepts. Do not invent new SKUs.
